tickets.title: Deleting an employee also deletes other employees whose EMPID starts with the same text
tickets.description: When HR deletes one employee, other employees disappear from the list too. Deleting EMP1 also removes EMP10 and EMP11. This is data loss in production.
steps: Open the User Management app (list has EMP1, EMP10 and EMP11)
Click Delete on the row EMP1 and confirm
tickets.expected: Only EMP1 is removed. EMP10 and EMP11 stay in the list. Deleting an EMPID that does not exist shows 'not found' and removes nothing.
tickets.actual: EMP1, EMP10 and EMP11 are all deleted.
acceptance_criteria: delete_user('EMP1') removes only the user with EMPID exactly EMP1
Deleting an unknown EMPID raises KeyError and removes nobody
Add, edit and list behaviour is unchanged

comments.author: HR Team
comments.body: We lost 2 employee records today after deleting a leaver. Please fix urgently.

tickets.title: The same EMPID can be added twice
tickets.description: Adding a user with an EMPID that already exists creates a second row. After that, Edit and Delete only ever act on the first of the two rows.
steps: Enter EMPID EMP2 (already in the list), any username and designation, then Save
tickets.expected: A clear error: 'EMPID EMP2 already exists' and no new row.
tickets.actual: A second EMP2 row is created.
acceptance_criteria: Adding an existing EMPID raises ValueError('EMPID <id> already exists')
The user list is unchanged after the rejected add
Adding a new, different EMPID still works

tickets.title: Blank or space-only values are accepted when adding or editing a user
tickets.description: The form lets you save empty or space-only EMPID, username or designation, which creates invisible-looking rows. Extra spaces around values are also saved as typed.
steps: Type a few spaces in Username, fill the other fields, then Save
tickets.expected: 'Username is required' error. Values like '  asha  ' are saved as 'asha'.
tickets.actual: A row with a blank username is created; spaces are kept.
acceptance_criteria: Blank, space-only or missing EMPID / username / designation raises ValueError('<Field> is required')
Leading and trailing spaces are trimmed before saving
The same rules apply when editing a user

tickets.title: User list does not refresh after adding a user
tickets.description: After saving a new user the table kept showing the old list until the page was reloaded.
tickets.actual: Row only appears after a page reload.
